Retains both oaths and the death-life pledge.
Keeps the awkward Abiathar action without replacing it with an unattested sacrifice.
Retains the difficult seer question and both fathers and sons.
Follows read plains rather than written crossings and retains the waiting plan.
Makes the report intelligible and preserves the prayer’s counsel-foolishness opposition.
